WHAT: Automated Vinted search quality evaluation pipeline — no Chrome needed per iteration.

HOW:
1. Fetches current search results via the app's own API (/api/searches/latest or similar)
2. Extracts image URLs from Vinted listing objects
3. Downloads reference photo + result images
4. Sends all to Gemini with prompt: 'Compare reference photo items to these Vinted listings, score 0-10 matches'
5. Outputs score per item + specific fix suggestions

MODEL: gemini-2.0-flash (same as identify endpoint)

USAGE:
  cd /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/vinted-fashion-finder
  npx tsx scripts/eval-all-items.ts

KEY GOTCHAS:
- import.meta.dirname undefined in tsx — use path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
- Prisma v7 import path changed, use direct sqlite3 or API instead
- Gemini model name: gemini-2.0-flash (not gemini-2.0-flash-latest)

BASELINE SCORES (iteration 1): Polo 30%, Chinos 40%, Sneakers 20%, Bag 10%, Sunglasses 70%, Belt 20%, Watch 0% — Overall 27%

FINAL SCORES (after 5 iterations): Polo ~63%, Sunglasses ~63%, Chinos ~46%, Belt ~43%, Bag ~35%, Sneakers ~30%, Watch ~20% — Overall ~48%
